description: Propagate supplied K-mismatch repetition records through the copied prefixes of a validated copy-overlap LZ factorization.

source.title: Approximate Tandem Repeats
source.operational_report: Kolpakov-Kucherov, Finding Approximate Repetitions under Hamming Distance, INRIA RR-4163 (2001), section 3, third stage
source.operational_paper: Kolpakov-Kucherov, Finding Maximal Repetitions in a Word in Linear Time, FOCS 1999, section 4
source.reuse: Algorithm descriptions only; implementations and fixtures are clean-room.

contract.terminal_precondition: The final symbol occurs nowhere earlier in the text.
contract.factorization: Copy-overlap LZ factors partition the text. Each later factor is the shortest prefix of the remaining suffix without an earlier occurrence; copy_start names any earlier occurrence of its maximal copied prefix. A zero-length prefix uses -1.
contract.seed_contract: Each seed is a globally maximal K-mismatch repetition with exact half-open bounds, positive period, and exact mismatch count. Duplicate seed triples are accepted and deduplicated.
contract.propagation: For each factor [a,b) with copy start c, delta=a-c and copy_end=c+(b-a-1). For target starts j in [a+1,b-2], propagate sorted records beginning at j-delta whose end_exclusive<=copy_end. Shift both endpoints by delta and retain only end_exclusive<=b-2. New records are available to later target starts and factors.
contract.duplicate_rule: Records are set-valued by (start,end_exclusive,period); exact duplicate triples are emitted once.
contract.output_scope: Within-factor copy propagation only over the supplied earlier-stage seed set; emit only newly added triples, not the seed set. The block-head and binary-division stages are not run.
contract.output_encoding: Little-endian signed-64 words [record_count,(start,end_exclusive,period,mismatches)*record_count], sorted by start, end_exclusive, period, then mismatches.
contract.validation_order: Validate the entire frame, factorization, and seeds before checking output nullness/capacity; errors write no bytes.

output.encoding: little-endian signed-64 count followed by four signed-64 fields per record

workspace.accounting: At most 372 four-field records (11,904 bytes with 64-bit fields), two 2,448-bit dedup maps (624 bytes), text/factor storage, counters, and traversal locals fit below 16,384 bytes; caller buffers are excluded.

complexity.primary: O(n^3+n^2*R+R^2) bounded validation, ordered-list scans, and sorted insertion; O(R) record storage, with n<=16 and R<=372.
complexity.independent_reference: O(n^3+n^2*R+R^2) bounded direct factor checks, whole-set scans, and deduplication; O(R) record storage, with n<=16 and R<=372.
